data.title: Root Canal Treatment
data.headline: Stop Toothache & Save Your Natural Tooth — Painless Root Canal Treatment
data.excerpt: Gentle rotary root canal therapy to clear deep nerve infection, stop throbbing pain, and save your natural tooth.
symptoms_json: Throbbing toothache that worsens at night
Lingering pain after hot tea/coffee or cold water
Sharp pain when biting or chewing food
Swollen gum or small pimple-like bump near a tooth
Deep black cavity or cracked tooth
Tooth darkening after an old injury
data.why_matters: When tooth decay or a crack reaches the inner nerve (pulp), painkillers only mask the ache temporarily. Cleaning and sealing the infected root removes the source of pain, stops infection from spreading to the jawbone, and avoids tooth extraction.

comparison_json.bestFor: Deep decay or nerve pain with intact root
Early surface cavities before nerve is reached

steps_json.title: Digital X-Ray & Numbing
steps_json.desc: Instant low-radiation X-ray locates the infection; numbing gel + local anesthesia ensures a pain-free start.

steps_json.title: Gentle Rotary Cleaning
steps_json.desc: Infected pulp is carefully removed and canals are shaped cleanly using quiet rotary instruments.

steps_json.title: Disinfection & Sealing
steps_json.desc: Canals are disinfected and sealed tightly with biocompatible filling so bacteria cannot re-enter.

steps_json.title: Protective Crown (Cap)
steps_json.desc: For back molars or weak teeth, a natural-looking ceramic/zirconia cap restores full chewing strength.

before: Eat a light meal 1–2 hours before your visit.
Inform the dentist about diabetes, blood thinners, or pregnancy so we tailor your care safely.
during: Topical numbing gel is applied before anesthesia—most patients feel only gentle pressure.
Most single-sitting root canals finish in 45–60 minutes in one calm appointment.
after: Avoid chewing on the treated side until numbness wears off (2–3 hours).
Mild bite tenderness for 24–48 hours is normal and settles quickly.
Do not skip your permanent crown/cap if advised—an uncapped molar can fracture under chewing force.

plan_factors_json: Which tooth is affected (front teeth have 1 canal; back molars have 3–4 canals)
Single-sitting vs. 2 visits if there is active swelling or curved roots
Whether a protective crown (PFM or Zirconia) is needed afterward
First-time procedure vs. re-treatment of an older root canal
data.clinical_note: Most patients walk in terrified of the phrase 'root canal' and walk out surprised that it felt like a routine filling. Our priority is complete numbing before we begin and an honest X-ray review so we only recommend a root canal when a simple filling cannot save the tooth.

faqs_json.a: No. With numbing gel, buffered local anesthesia, and rotary instruments, the procedure is painless and relieves the throbbing ache you walked in with.

faqs_json.q: Can my root canal be done in a single sitting?
faqs_json.a: Many uncomplicated cases finish in one 45–60 minute sitting. If there is active swelling or curved roots, 2 visits are safer.

faqs_json.q: Is a dental cap (crown) mandatory after a root canal?
faqs_json.a: Strongly recommended for back chewing teeth (molars/premolars) to prevent fractures; front teeth with minimal damage sometimes only need a bonded filling.

faqs_json.q: Can I eat normally after a root canal?
faqs_json.a: Wait 2–3 hours until numbness fades, eat soft foods on the opposite side for 1–2 days, and chew normally once the final restoration/cap is placed.

faqs_json.q: What happens if I just take painkillers and delay treatment?
faqs_json.a: Painkillers mask symptoms briefly while infection spreads, risking facial swelling, abscess formation, or losing a saveable tooth.

faqs_json.q: Is root canal treatment safe during pregnancy or for diabetic patients?
faqs_json.a: Yes, with proper precautions—checking blood sugar control for diabetics and coordinating safe timing/anesthesia during pregnancy.

data.title: Dental Implants
data.headline: Eat & Smile Naturally Again — 3D-Planned Dental Implants
data.excerpt: Permanent titanium tooth replacement that looks, feels, and chews just like a natural tooth.
symptoms_json: Loose dentures slipping while speaking or eating
Neighboring teeth tilting into an old gap
data.why_matters: Leaving a missing tooth gap causes neighboring teeth to tilt and jawbone to shrink over time. A titanium implant acts like a natural root, preserving jawbone strength and confident chewing.

comparison_json.bestFor: Faster fixed option when bone is limited

steps_json.title: 3D CBCT Bone Scan
steps_json.desc: Precise jawbone density and nerve mapping before planning.

steps_json.title: Gentle Implant Placement
steps_json.desc: Painless titanium root placement under local numbing.

steps_json.title: Bone Integration
steps_json.desc: Bone bonds naturally with the implant over 8–12 weeks.

steps_json.title: Custom Ceramic Crown
steps_json.desc: Shade-matched crown fixed for a natural bite.

before: Bring recent HbA1c (if diabetic) or blood-thinner details.
during: Complete local numbing ensures a calm, predictable placement.
after: Cold pack for 24 hours; soft cool-to-warm foods for 2–3 days; avoid smoking during healing.

data.clinical_note: A 3D CBCT scan before quoting lets us measure your exact bone height and nerve safety—so your implant plan is predictable from day one.

faqs_json.a: Done under effective local anesthesia so you feel mild vibration, not sharp pain. Post-visit soreness is usually milder than an extraction.

faqs_json.q: Can diabetic or senior patients get dental implants?
faqs_json.a: Yes, once blood sugar and general health are well controlled; age alone is rarely a barrier.

faqs_json.q: How long do dental implants last?
faqs_json.a: With daily brushing, flossing, and 6-month checkups, the titanium implant post can last decades.

data.title: Clear Aligners
data.headline: Straighten Teeth Discreetly — Specialist-Planned Clear Aligners
data.excerpt: Transparent, removable trays to straighten crowded or gapped teeth without metal brackets.
data.why_matters: Crowded or misaligned teeth are harder to clean and wear unevenly. Specialist-planned aligners straighten teeth gradually while letting you eat and brush normally.

steps_json.title: 3D Digital Smile Scan
steps_json.desc: Gag-free scan with a preview of your projected smile.

steps_json.title: Custom Aligner Sets
steps_json.desc: Precision-trimmed BPA-free transparent trays.

steps_json.title: Wear & Progress Checks
steps_json.desc: Wear 20–22 hrs/day; switch trays every 10–14 days.

steps_json.title: Retainers
steps_json.desc: Nighttime retainers lock your aligned smile in place.

before: Ensure cavities and routine cleaning are done before scanning.
during: Remove trays only while eating, drinking hot beverages, and brushing.
after: Wear retainers as advised so teeth never shift back.

plan_factors_json: Complexity of crowding or bite correction
Total number of aligner trays needed
data.clinical_note: Every aligner case is planned by an MDS Orthodontist—not an unsupervised mail-order kit—so your bite stays healthy as your smile aligns.

faqs_json.q: How many hours a day must aligners be worn?
faqs_json.a: 20 to 22 hours daily, removing them only for meals, hot drinks, and brushing.
A slight lisp for the first 2–3 days is common and fades quickly.

data.title: Teeth Whitening
data.headline: Safe, Sensitivity-Controlled In-Clinic Teeth Whitening
data.excerpt: Clinically monitored LED brightening to lift tea, coffee, and aging stains in a single session.
data.why_matters: Dentist-supervised whitening protects gums with a barrier and uses controlled clinical gels for predictable shade lift without harsh abrasion.

steps_json.title: Shade Check & Polish
steps_json.desc: Record baseline shade and clear surface plaque.

steps_json.title: Gum Shielding
steps_json.desc: Protective gel covers gums and soft tissue.

steps_json.title: Activated Whitening
steps_json.desc: Two gentle 15-minute clinical gel cycles.

steps_json.title: Desensitizing Finish
steps_json.desc: Mineral paste soothes enamel immediately.

before: A quick scaling beforehand helps whitening gel work evenly.
during: Relax while gums remain fully shielded.
after: Avoid dark tea, coffee, turmeric, or red wine for 48 hours.

data.clinical_note: We check for hidden cavities or thin enamel before whitening so you get a bright result without lingering sensitivity.

faqs_json.a: No. Professionally monitored whitening lifts stains from enamel pores without thinning tooth structure.
Typically 6 to 18 months depending on tea/coffee habits and routine cleanings.

data.title: Checkup & Scaling
data.headline: Preventive Dental Checkup & Gentle Ultrasonic Cleaning
data.excerpt: Full tooth-by-tooth exam, gum health check, and gentle tartar removal to stop problems early.
data.why_matters: Most serious dental pain starts as silent plaque or tiny cavities. A 30-minute preventive checkup catches issues when they are simple and quick to fix.

steps_json.title: Oral & Gum Screening
steps_json.desc: Check teeth, gums, and existing fillings.

steps_json.title: Ultrasonic Scaling
steps_json.desc: Water-cooled vibrations lift hardened tartar gently.

steps_json.title: Smooth Polishing
steps_json.desc: Polishes away surface tea/coffee stains.

steps_json.title: Prevention Plan
steps_json.desc: Clear home-care tips with zero upsell pressure.

during: Let us know if any spot feels sensitive—we adjust the setting immediately.
after: Mild cold sensitivity for 24 hours after heavy tartar removal is normal.

plan_factors_json: Whether baseline digital X-rays are needed
data.clinical_note: Scaling does NOT loosen healthy teeth—it removes hardened tartar that silently damages gums and bone underneath.

faqs_json.q: Does scaling weaken or loosen teeth?
faqs_json.a: No. Ultrasonic scaling only vibrates off hardened tartar deposits without cutting healthy tooth enamel.

data.title: Kids Dentistry
data.headline: Fear-Free Kids Dentistry for Growing Smiles
data.excerpt: Calm cavity prevention, fluoride shields, and gentle care designed to build lifelong dental confidence.
symptoms_json: Black spots or cavities on milk teeth
Child complaining of pain while eating sweets
data.why_matters: Healthy milk teeth guide permanent teeth into the right position. Early gentle visits prevent dental fear later in life.

steps_json.title: Tell-Show-Do Welcome
steps_json.desc: Kids see tools playfully before any exam.

steps_json.title: Gentle Checkup
steps_json.desc: Check cavities, jaw spacing, and brushing habits.

steps_json.title: Protective Shield
steps_json.desc: Quick fluoride varnish or molar sealant if needed.

steps_json.title: Parent Care Guide
steps_json.desc: Practical brushing and snack tips for home.

before: Talk positively about the visit—avoid words like 'pain' or 'injection'.
during: Parents stay right beside the child for reassurance.
after: Avoid sticky sweets for 2 hours after fluoride varnish.

data.clinical_note: We never rush a nervous child—building trust on the first visit makes every future checkup effortless.

faqs_json.q: Why treat cavities in milk teeth if they will fall out?
faqs_json.a: Untreated decay causes pain, infection, and early tooth loss, which leads to crooked permanent teeth.

data.title: Crowns & Veneers
data.headline: Natural-Looking Zirconia Crowns & Porcelain Veneers
data.excerpt: Custom shade-matched crowns and veneers to protect weak teeth or restore chipped, worn smiles.
symptoms_json: Tooth needing protection after root canal
Small gaps or uneven tooth edges
data.why_matters: A well-fitted zirconia crown protects a fragile tooth from splitting, while ultra-thin veneers refine smile symmetry naturally.

steps_json.title: Shade & Bite Assessment
steps_json.desc: Match natural tooth translucency and bite.

steps_json.title: Gentle Prep & Scan
steps_json.desc: Precise shaping + comfortable temporary cap.

steps_json.title: CAD/CAM Lab Craft
steps_json.desc: High-strength zirconia or porcelain fabrication.

steps_json.title: Final Bonding
steps_json.desc: Check comfort, bite, and natural look before sealing.

before: Tell us if you grind teeth at night so we pick the strongest ceramic.
during: Local numbing keeps preparation completely comfortable.
after: Avoid biting ice or hard shells directly on front veneers.

data.clinical_note: Digital shade matching ensures your crown blends seamlessly—no opaque 'fake' look or dark metal line at the gum.

faqs_json.q: How long do zirconia crowns last?
faqs_json.a: Typically 10–15+ years with good brushing and regular dental checkups.

data.title: Gum & Wisdom Care
data.headline: Gentle Gum Treatment & Wisdom Tooth Removal
data.excerpt: Targeted care for bleeding gums, gum pockets, and painful impacted wisdom teeth with smooth healing.
symptoms_json: Pain or swelling at the very back of the jaw
Gums that bleed easily or feel tender
Food constantly trapped behind back tooth
data.why_matters: Impacted wisdom teeth trap bacteria and damage neighboring molars, while untreated gum disease gradually weakens tooth support.

comparison_json.bestFor: Impacted or repeatedly infected wisdom teeth

steps_json.title: Digital OPG / X-Ray
steps_json.desc: Check exact root angle and nearby nerve position.

steps_json.title: Complete Numbing
steps_json.desc: Confirm full numbness before starting.

steps_json.title: Gentle Procedure
steps_json.desc: Minimally invasive removal or laser gum cleaning.

steps_json.title: Recovery Kit & Follow-Up
steps_json.desc: Written healing checklist + 7-day check.

before: Eat a normal meal 1–2 hours before wisdom tooth removal.
during: You feel gentle pressure, never sharp pain.
after: Bite gently on gauze for 30–45 mins, avoid straws/spitting for 24 hours, and eat soft cool foods.

plan_factors_json: Simple erupted extraction vs. surgically impacted wisdom tooth
data.clinical_note: Not every wisdom tooth needs removal—we check your X-ray first and only recommend extraction when it is causing infection, decay, or crowding.

faqs_json.q: How many days does wisdom tooth recovery take?
faqs_json.a: Most patients return to desk work in 1–2 days, with gum healing progressing comfortably over 5–7 days.
